brand.name: Chakravyuh
brand.description: A free UPSC prep app that gives working aspirants a daily study plan sized to their free time, past questions and short notes.
brand.audience: UPSC CSE 2027 aspirants aged 21-32, many with a job, in Tier-2 and Tier-3 Indian cities
brand.tone: like a senior who cleared the exam: calm, clear, encouraging
brand.services:
Daily study plan sized to your free time
Previous year questions (PYQ) with short answers
Short notes for revision
Weekly mock test
brand.dos: Speak to working aspirants; give one useful tip per post
brand.donts: No rank promises, no coaching-style hype, no prices
brand.keyFacts: Free, no ads. UPSC Prelims 2027: 23 May 2027. Android app on Google Play.
brand.visualStyle: Young Indian aspirants studying at home, in hostels and libraries; natural light; calm

campaign.theme: Prelims 2027 countdown: start your daily plan
campaign.goal: More app installs from working aspirants

learnings.text: On instagram, carousels get 2.1x the engagement of image posts (9 posts). Plan more of them.
On instagram, posts in the evening get 1.8x the engagement (7 posts). Post around 19:00.
Captions that open with a question get 1.6x the engagement (6 posts). Open most captions that way.
